changelog: DeskAI v2.18.0 (Build 72): the menu, regrouped. Tiles under Your agent, Make and The Mini, with live details (tasks running and waiting, retasks saved, the next scheduled run) instead of OPEN. Fewer buttons: the Standby button, the settings gear and the three-dot button are gone from the home screen (the Connection Hub is in the menu; /standby and /wake still work).
